study_type: Controlled pilot plus separate profiler diagnostic
limitations: Two unprofiled trials per condition are a pilot, not a stable population estimate.
The profiler diagnostic has severe overhead and is used only to prove GPU-time overlap, not to estimate slowdown.
The independent copy worker transfers synthetic bytes, not a naturally resumed session's KV blocks.
Overlap and slowdown do not isolate device-memory bandwidth from copy-engine, PCIe, or other shared-resource effects.
This A10G has GDDR6, not HBM; repeat on GH200 before making an HBM-specific claim.
